## Chapters without separate companion code

Chapters 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 15, 42 and 45 have **no separate companion source files** in this
repository. Their code (where present) appears inline in the book text. This is stated here rather
than left for the reader to discover.
